plan.invariant: Mutation requires an approved plan bound to the exact current plan digest.

permission.invariant: Deny cannot be overridden; dangerous, wrapped, asked, and unknown actions require exact action approval.

tool_trust.invariant: Capability use requires approval bound to the exact capability digest; a matching name is insufficient.

verification.invariant: Completion requires independent, subject-bound, evidence-bearing verification with a PASS verdict.

runtime.invariant: Unknown usage and hard stops block; approval thresholds ask unless exact bounded overage approval exists.

workflow.mutation_invariant: Every mutation gate must return allow.
workflow.completion_invariant: Mutation must have been authorized and verification must return allow.

evidence_contract.reference_conformance: Every frozen case must match its exact expected decision.
evidence_contract.mutation_analysis: Every named unsafe mutant must be detected by at least one frozen case.
evidence_contract.reproducibility: The report contains no timestamp or environment-dependent value and includes protocol and fixture SHA-256 digests.
evidence_contract.claim_boundary: A passing packet proves conformance of this deterministic reference evaluator to this fixture corpus. It does not prove real-agent safety, effectiveness, cost reduction, or production outcomes.
